title: Easy Links
description: Replaces chat links with a [link] placeholder.
body:
## Tired of non-clickable links in chat? I’ve got the solution!

_My plugin was originally made for my Paper 1.21.1 server, but I decided to upload it here too :)  
It might work on higher versions, though I haven’t tested it..._

Just install the plugin and you're good to go! **No configuration required** ✅

If you run into any issues, message me on Telegram! @AlexsandrDeveloper  
_(Also contact me if you’re interested in buying the plugin’s source code)_

If you liked this plugin, I would **REALLY** appreciate your support through a donation ❤️

### **[[DonationAlerts]](https://www.donationalerts.com/r/alexsam1075)**
